Bindings are changed in memory only and put back (no card or settings save). Predeclared: chat-bound ready (satisfiedBy chat; file mode also names the slot conflict), persona-bound ready (persona), bound to one of two members MISSING with the gap named (D2), bound to both ready (character). The two file-mode displacement legs (a) story book first then adoption and (b) mirror first then the author binds through ST's UI are run by hand on the lane with so-ui, recorded beside this run. T7 wave C (2026-10-03): story-scoped lore (T5-2-2, f7342021; src/runtime/storyLore.ts, requirementsRead.ts sourceOf) meets a listed book with source 'story' whenever the host orders scan listeners, so the unbound leg now reads READY by 'story' (it read missing before; never by a global selection, asserted), and the one-of-two-members leg is met by 'story' too, with no card gap (D2's missing-with-gap reading is only reachable without story lore: requirements.test.ts). Chat, persona and every-member bindings still win over 'story' (sourceOf checks them first). The book is deleted at the end and by cleanup (so-assets marker SO-V25-08), and no SO-V25-08 book may stay selected globally (T7 lane residue).
